Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: Hunsicker, David <David.Hunsicker@wichita.edu>
Sent: Saturday, August 17, 2019 2:44 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: Tigers, etc. 
 
Anthony,
You are now my best source for everything Tigers related. Jason Beck is in the running, but the News hasn’t really filled Lynn Henning’s shoes, IMO.
I would love to know if you have any information on Yoandy Rea. Not much of an arm, but seems to have a heck of a bat. MiLB doesn’t even have a page for him.

Next, Derek Hill. Did he make some kind of adjustment at the plate (.400 on his last 10 games), or is it just the ups and downs of a season? Would love to be able to ask the coaches myself, but I’m not sure they’d take my call.

All the best and know that there are dedicated fans who understand how a rebuild works. (The same people who were screaming “Suck for Luck!” a few years back are the ones complaining about the Tigers now. They just can’t see how it’s the same. If the Tigers finish dead last, they have a chance at the #2 prospect in all of baseball. I thought it was obvious that the Tigers have a massive motivation to lose right now - something MLB needs to and might be forced to address in the next CBA. Lottery system anyone?)
Thanks again and keep it up. My favorite articles of yours were from Spring training when you seemed to tick someone off in the front office. Loved it.

Dr. David Hunsicker
Trumpet Professor, Wichita State University
Principal Trumpet, Wichita Symphony Orchestra
Principal Trumpet, Lancaster Festival Orchestra
